decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to utilize the Hardened Scales enchantment to bolster the +1/+1 counters placed on creatures like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and Walking Ballista. By maximizing the effectiveness of the counters, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and use synergies such as The Ozolith to keep the pressure on. Urza's Saga helps to find key artifacts like Hangarback Walker and Arcbound Ravager, while cards like Welding Jar and Gemstone Caverns provide additional utility and mana acceleration. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, efficient creature-based aggression with a focus on +1/+1 counters.

This deck focuses on using Hardened Scales to enhance the +1/+1 counters placed on creatures, particularly through cards like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista. The goal is to quickly build up a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures that benefit from the additional counters. The Ozolith serves as a way to preserve the counters even if creatures are removed, while cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp provide additional synergy with counters. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga to help with consistency and resilience.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to combo with Dwarven Mine tokens and Leyline Binding to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six provides additional value and recursion. The deck aims to disrupt opponents while setting up a game-winning combo through creative use of its cards.

This deck focuses on using Hardened Scales to boost the +1/+1 counters placed on creatures like Hangarback Walker, Arcbound Ravager, and Walking Ballista. The goal is to quickly build a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with creatures that grow in size rapidly. The inclusion of cards like The Ozolith and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp helps to ensure that the +1/+1 counters are not wasted when creatures are removed. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts and lands to further strengthen its position on the battlefield.

The main concept of this Modern Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to aggressively reduce your own life total to maximize the power of Death's Shadow while also utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Traverse the Ulvenwald to find key pieces of your deck. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Abrupt Decay to control the opponent's game plan. Dress Down provides versatility and Grist, the Hunger Tide offers additional threats. This deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy while efficiently deploying powerful threats.

The primary focus of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan while also applying pressure with efficient and powerful creatures. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Terminate, and Grief to strip away key cards from the opponent's hand, combined with Lightning Bolt for early removal and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Bloodtithe Harvester, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total quickly and efficiently. The deck also has a graveyard recursion theme with Undying Malice and Feign Death to keep the pressure on.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to handle opposing threats, as well as disruptive elements such as Blood Moon to disrupt mana bases. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain that pressure throughout the game, using various cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Feign Death to generate additional value and push towards victory.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Archon of Cruelty, while also utilizing cards like Persist and Lingering Souls for value and disruption. The deck also leans heavily on the Dwarven Mine token generation strategy to ramp out larger threats quickly. With a mix of removal, hand disruption, and card draw, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential and resilience. The key idea is to combo off with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ziatora's Proving Ground to create a strong board presence and win the game.

The deck focuses on being proactive and putting pressure on the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. It also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce help protect your creatures and counter key spells from the opponent. The deck's mana base is optimized with fetch lands like Scalding Tarn and cantrips like Expressive Iteration to ensure a smooth and consistent gameplay.

This deck revolves around utilizing cascade effects to quickly deploy threats onto the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's plans. By casting cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, players can cascade into powerful spells such as Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone. The deck also includes counterspells like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of aggro strategies and cascade mechanics, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to assemble a strong board presence and achieve victory through a combination of tutoring, sacrificing, and generating value. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, along with creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Strangleroot Geist, the deck can quickly adapt to different situations and outmaneuver opponents. The inclusion of key lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth help to support the deck's strategy, while cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Endurance provide additional utility and resilience.

This deck focuses on cycling through cards to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by getting creatures with powerful abilities onto the battlefield at a low cost, overwhelming them with an army of creatures. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the goal is to execute the combo efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

This deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp up mana production and efficiently play big threats like Primeval Titan. The key strategy is to use lands like Simic Growth Chamber and bounce lands to generate multiple mana triggers with Amulet of Vigor, allowing for explosive plays and combos. By using cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Urza's Saga, the deck can search for specific lands and assemble a powerful board state quickly. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and land synergy to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's plays through a combination of removal spells, disruptive creatures, and powerful planeswalkers. It aims to control the game tempo by using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending to stall the opponent's strategy, while also utilizing powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game quickly once control is established. The deck has a diverse mana base to support its multicolored spells and has access to a range of powerful sideboard options for different matchups.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies combined with the ability to repeatedly blink creatures for value. By utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Giver of Runes, and Archon of Emeria, the deck can apply pressure while disrupting the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Melira, the Living Cure provide additional protection and utility. With the ability to search for equipment with Stoneforge Mystic and blink creatures for additional triggers, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on ramping quickly into powerful land-based combos, allowing you to search for key lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Urza's Saga. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, you can accelerate your mana production and play multiple lands each turn. This enables you to quickly tutor for and play Primeval Titan, which can search for even more powerful lands and put immense pressure on your opponent. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its key pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its potent land-based combos.
